versions.provenance: International Workshop on Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (iwCLL) guidelines for Rai and Binet staging; licensed clinical reference.
versions.introduction: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) is staged clinically without surgery or TNM staging using the Rai System (predominantly in the US) and the Binet System (predominantly in Europe). Both systems rely on simple physical examination and standard complete blood counts (CBC) to determine risk category, symptom-free survival, and indication for therapy.

t.label: Absolute peripheral blood B-cell count >= 5 x 10^9/L (5000/mcL) with >=30% lymphocytes in bone marrow; no adenopathy, hepatosplenomegaly, anemia, or thrombocytopenia
Lymphadenopathy in any site (cervical, axillary, inguinal)
Hepatomegaly and/or splenomegaly with or without lymphadenopathy
Hemoglobin < 11.0 g/dL (Rai) or < 10.0 g/dL (Binet) due to bone marrow marrow infiltration
Platelet count < 100 x 10^9/L (100,000/mcL) due to bone marrow infiltration

n.label: Fewer than 3 lymphoid areas involved (cervical, axillary, inguinal, spleen, liver)

stageGroups.basis: Low risk. Median survival >10-12 years. Active surveillance (watch-and-wait) standard of care.
Intermediate risk. Median survival 7-9 years. Treatment indicated only if active/symptomatic disease (iwCLL criteria).
Intermediate risk. Median survival 7-9 years. Treat if symptomatic splenomegaly or progressive organomegaly.
High risk. Median survival 1.5-3 years without therapy. Standard indication for targeted therapy (BTKi: Ibrutinib/Acalabrutinib/Zanubrutinib, or Venetoclax + Obinutuzumab).
High risk. Median survival 1.5-3 years without therapy. Requires immediate evaluation for systemic targeted therapy.
Survival comparable to age-matched controls. Watch and wait.
Intermediate risk. Watch and wait unless disease progression.
High risk. Anemia (Hb <10 g/dL) and/or Thrombocytopenia (<100 x 10^9/L). Treatment mandatory.

versions.regionalNodes: 5 clinical lymphoid areas for Binet: cervical (unilateral or bilateral = 1 area), axillary (unilateral or bilateral = 1 area), inguinal (unilateral or bilateral = 1 area), liver (1 area), spleen (1 area).
versions.histologicGrade: Not applicable. Clonality assessed by flow cytometry (CD5+, CD19+, CD23+, CD20 dim, surface Ig dim, CD43+).
versions.histopathologicTypes: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia / Small lymphocytic lymphoma (SLL).
prognosticFactors: IGHV mutation status (unmutated IGHV predicts aggressive course and shorter time to treatment)
TP53 mutation or del(17p) deletion: confers chemoimmunotherapy resistance; mandates BTK inhibitor or Venetoclax regimens
CLL-IPI (International Prognostic Index): TP53 status (4 pts), IGHV unmutated (2 pts), Serum B2M >3.5 mg/L (2 pts), Rai I-IV or Binet B-C (1 pt), Age >65 (1 pt)
